name: GLO corner frontage
observations: Upper red-brick corner above a white painted ground-floor wall.
GLO pale fascia and wide light-framed display window face the junction; glazing has divided transom/frame structure.
An upper window/opening bears a GLO panel; adjacent upper windows have simple light rectangular frames.
Building turns the corner, with blank white wall and smaller openings along the Melton-facing return.
Flower/decorative entry trim visible near the corner door; direction sign and beacon pole stand independently in foreground.
Curved pavement/double-yellow kerb wraps the corner; keep frontage, kerb and poles separate.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.
